Question B-004-006-006.

Why the correct answer is right: Highest precision means the smallest tolerance percentage, so 0.1% is the most precise listed value.

Why the distractors are wrong:
- sourceIndex 1: "5%": This is less precise than 0.1%. Numeric check: 5% is fifty times larger than 0.1%.
- sourceIndex 2: "10%": A 10% tolerance allows a much wider spread than 0.1%. On a 100-ohm part it permits about +/-10 ohms instead of about +/-0.1 ohm.
- sourceIndex 3: "20%": This is the widest tolerance listed here, not the highest precision. Numeric check: 20% is larger than 10%, 5%, and 0.1%.
